note: Data is expressed in constant 2024 US$. The OECD's climate tracking excludes general budget support, debt relief, and costs in donor countries, such as hosting refugees. In 2010, around one-third of projects were not screened for climate objectives; since 2014, this unscreened share has been less than 10%.
title: Foreign aid given for climate mitigation and adaptation
subtitle: Committed bilateral [official development assistance (ODA)](#dod:oda) covered by the OECD's climate tracking, by whether projects target climate change mitigation, adaptation, or both. This data is expressed in US dollars and adjusted for inflation.
